en: Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a large hilltop complex with a castle-like building and an adjacent Gothic cathedral. The cathedral's twin west towers are surrounded by dense scaffolding while a slender completed spire rises between them. Below, along the riverside, lumber yards and workshops line the embankment; a smokestack and several small boats are visible. German signage appears on riverside buildings.
